title: lastrea squamigera
intro: Lastrea squamigera, commonly known as the Maidenhair fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in treating wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Lastrea squamigera include its ability to reduce inflammation, inhibit bacterial growth, and modulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
